title: Introducing MicroLighter: A Lightweight Client-Side Syntax Highlighter Using CSS Custom Highlights API
summary: MicroLighter is a minimal, dependency-free client-side syntax highlighter leveraging the CSS Custom Highlights API. It avoids DOM mutation by using `::highlight()` pseudo-elements, supports on-demand loading of Textmate language grammars, and simplifies theming with `light-dark()` for unified light/dark mode styles. The core library focuses on highlighting, while additional features like line numbers are handled via a separate `<micro-lighter>` web component.
key_points: Uses CSS `::highlight()` pseudo-elements instead of injecting `<span>` tags, avoiding DOM mutation.
Leverages Textmate language grammars (used by VS Code) for robust syntax support.
Auto-loads language grammars on-demand to minimize bundle size.
Simplifies theming with `light-dark()` for unified light/dark mode styles.
Core library focuses solely on syntax highlighting; additional features (e.g., line numbers) are delegated to a `<micro-lighter>` web component (~1KB).
Supports ESM, self-initializing bundles, and custom element integration.
Human-readable token categories for easier styling (e.g., `--syntax-comment`, `--syntax-function`).
Extensible via web component class inheritance for custom features.
